scripts.db:seed-engines: node --env-file=.env.local -e "import mysql from 'mysql2/promise'; import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; const u=new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL); const c=await mysql.createConnection({host:u.hostname,port:Number(u.port||3306),user:decodeURIComponent(u.username),password:decodeURIComponent(u.password),database:u.pathname.slice(1),multipleStatements:true}); await c.query(readFileSync('scripts/seed-engines.sql','utf8')); await c.end();"
